description: Loki queries over run_local's run, step, crate, build and service events (service_name=local-telemetry), read by both local-dashboard.nix and scripts/ci-report.ts --spec local. $NAME expands to filters.NAME and $RANGE to the window. Every filter names the machine (its `machine` field, or on older events its `host_name` or hashed `host`), and the dashboard narrows each one to its Machine variable.

filters.READY: {service_name="local-telemetry"} | event="run" | kind="up" | outcome="success" | label_format machine="{{ or .machine .host_name .host }}"
filters.STOPPED: {service_name="local-telemetry"} | event="run" | kind="up" | outcome!="success" | label_format machine="{{ or .machine .host_name .host }}"
filters.TOP: {service_name="local-telemetry"} | event="step" | kind="up" | parent_step="" | label_format machine="{{ or .machine .host_name .host }}"
filters.CRIT: {service_name="local-telemetry"} | event="step" | kind="up" | lane="main" | parent_step="" | label_format machine="{{ or .machine .host_name .host }}"
filters.NESTED: {service_name="local-telemetry"} | event="step" | kind="up" | parent_step!="" | label_format machine="{{ or .machine .host_name .host }}"

tables.title: run_local: time to ready
tables.description: Bring-ups (attached, detached and run_dev) from the first step to a backend answering through the proxy with Vite started.

tables.title: Machines
tables.description: Each machine's bring-ups: its `machine` setting, or a hash of its hostname when it has none. CPUs and memory tell hashed machines apart; memory arrives only from runs recorded since it was added. Build is the cargo build of the service binaries in a bring-up.

columns.name: Ready
columns.expr: (sum by (machine) (count_over_time($READY [$RANGE])) or 0 * sum by (machine) (count_over_time($RUN [$RANGE]))) / sum by (machine) (count_over_time($RUN [$RANGE]))

columns.name: sccache hits
columns.expr: sum by (machine) (sum_over_time($BUILD | unwrap sccache_hits | __error__="" [$RANGE])) / (sum by (machine) (sum_over_time($BUILD | unwrap sccache_hits | __error__="" [$RANGE])) + sum by (machine) (sum_over_time($BUILD | unwrap sccache_misses | __error__="" [$RANGE])))

tables.title: Time to ready by start
tables.description: Fresh starts wipe the instance's data; resumes keep it. Detached runs are the ones agents and pipes start.

tables.title: Bring-up steps by p90
tables.description: Every bring-up step, including the background teardown and frontend lanes, which overlap the foreground: steps don't sum to the run.

tables.title: Critical path by step
tables.description: The foreground steps a bring-up waits on in order (lane main, not nested in another step), by fresh or resumed start. Share is the step's part of all foreground time for that start: the biggest share is the bottleneck. Recorded since runs gained lanes; older events have none.

columns.name: Share
columns.expr: sum by (start, step) (sum_over_time($CRIT | unwrap seconds | __error__="" [$RANGE])) / on (start) group_left sum by (start) (sum_over_time($CRIT | unwrap seconds | __error__="" [$RANGE]))

tables.title: Nested steps
tables.description: Steps that run inside another step, such as a computer image's Nix build and its Docker load.

tables.title: Slowest crates in service builds
tables.description: Units cargo compiled for at least a second in a service build, from `cargo build --timings`; workspace says whether the crate is in this repository. A build that compiles nothing records no crates.

columns.name: p50
columns.expr: quantile_over_time(0.5, $CRATE | unwrap seconds | __error__="" [$RANGE]) by (crate, target, workspace)

columns.name: p90
columns.expr: quantile_over_time(0.9, $CRATE | unwrap seconds | __error__="" [$RANGE]) by (crate, target, workspace)

columns.name: Hours
columns.expr: sum by (crate, target, workspace) (sum_over_time($CRATE | unwrap seconds | __error__="" [$RANGE])) / 3600

tables.title: Failed and interrupted bring-ups by step
tables.description: The step a failed run stopped at, or for an interrupted run (killed, or stopped mid-bring-up) the step it was in.

tables.title: Slowest services to turn healthy
tables.description: From a container starting to its first passing health probe. Services without a health check have no row.

tables.title: Service builds
tables.description: The cargo build of the service binaries, in bring-ups and rebuilds. Units are what cargo compiled; the sccache hit rate counts the whole shared server during the build.

columns.name: sccache hits
columns.expr: sum by (kind) (sum_over_time($BUILD | unwrap sccache_hits | __error__="" [$RANGE])) / (sum by (kind) (sum_over_time($BUILD | unwrap sccache_hits | __error__="" [$RANGE])) + sum by (kind) (sum_over_time($BUILD | unwrap sccache_misses | __error__="" [$RANGE])))

tables.title: Rebuilds, restarts and stops
tables.description: Commands on a running stack: `just run_local rebuild`, `restart-frontend`, `stop`, and the r and f hotkeys.
